original_test_intent: Verify every SMBIOS Type 4 processor record, cache linkage and topology/count field against the installed CPU recipe and prove correct persistence after reboot.
original_method: Capture every full Type 4 record with DMI handle and socket identity, resolve cache handles, compare 25 named fields using explicit dynamic and SMBIOS-version rules, reboot under approval/recovery, then repeat and diff each stable socket.
manual_activity: Owner supplies installed-socket and field oracles, SMBIOS count semantics and dynamic-field policy, approves protected evidence/reboot, and provides recovery.
required_inputs: Exact host/BMC and installed CPU/socket topology
SMBIOS version and legacy/extended count rules
safety_requirements: Do not suppress errors or bypass target authentication
Resolve cache handles and count-field semantics
Stop on missing socket or abnormal boot
agent_execution_scope: Capture every Type 4 and referenced cache record
Map by socket designation plus handle
Compare identity, topology and permitted runtime values
engineer_actions: Supply socket recipe and SMBIOS count rules
Resolve missing/duplicate socket or cache links

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `dmidecode -t 4` is relevant, but a one-line grep cannot collect 25 fields, distinguish sockets or resolve cache handles; insecure SSH and suppressed errors further invalidate it.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely collect complete Type 4 records for all sockets plus referenced Type 7 caches before and after an approved reboot; map stably and compare every named field under version/dynamic policies.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All 25 named fields, correctness, pre/post comparison, reboot persistence and 5/5-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a socket-keyed graph joining Type 4 records to Type 7 handles, normalize count fields by SMBIOS revision and preserve raw output for every socket.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete multi-socket, link-aware and version-aware evidence instead of a single header snippet.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects missing/duplicated processors, wrong cache links, topology/count truncation, identity drift and disallowed runtime variation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Socket designations or handles may reorder after firmware changes; stable matching needs multiple invariant attributes and must flag ambiguous matches.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC must define installed versus unpopulated sockets, processor-count rules, permitted runtime-field ranges and whether exact handle numbers or resolved relationships are invariant.
expected_evidence: Complete pre/post Type 4 for every socket
No hardware PASS claim by the agent

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently specifies Type 4 processor information and reboot persistence; legacy and extended count fields require version interpretation but do not conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Topology, field/version/dynamic policies, decoder and reboot controls are finite inputs; absence delays execution rather than review.

review_improvement: Prevents a single truncated record from passing a multi-socket, cache-linked and SMBIOS-version-dependent processor inventory test.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 4 is repeated per socket and includes references plus legacy and extended topology counts. Treating output as one flat record can hide an absent CPU or overflowed legacy count. Complete socket-keyed, version-aware evidence is essential; reboot authorization makes the final classification REQUIRES.
